lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with larger diameter blobs concentrated along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance transition with high intensity on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small-diameter, high-luminance spots across its visible dorsal surface.
